# Redemption Checklist: Coupons and Discount Codes

**Purpose**: Requirements quality for concurrency, money correctness and security of coupon redemption (PR reviewer, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-11-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Concurrency and Consistency

- [ ] CHK001 Is "at most N live redemptions" defined for every state a redemption can be in (reserved, permanent, released)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the writers that touch the redemption count (checkout start, expiry, webhook, instructor edits) all named, so the single shared write helper has a complete list? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the outcome defined when a limit is lowered while reservations are in flight, and when it is raised? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for a "paid" event arriving after the reservation was released? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is idempotency stated for each repeatable request (checkout start, free enrolment, release), with the expected result of a repeat? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the invariants listed precisely enough to be breakable by a test (what exactly counts as a live redemption)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the interaction between "one unpaid order per course" and a refused second code defined? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007]

## Money Correctness

- [ ] CHK008 Is rounding specified for percent discounts, with an example, and consistent between the preview, checkout and the order? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated that the server's total, never a browser amount, is what is charged? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the units (minor units, currency) specified for fixed amounts, the order snapshot and the instructor's entry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the below-minimum-charge case defined for every discount type, including its message? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the order snapshot contain everything #286 needs to reconcile without reading the code, and is that need stated? [Dependency, Spec §FR-009, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements defined for list-price and currency changes after a code exists, and do they leave existing orders untouched? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the behaviour defined when a refund occurs on a discounted order, including whether the redemption is returned? [Gap, Spec §Clarifications]

## Security and Privacy

- [ ] CHK015 Is it specified who may create, list, change and delete codes, and who may read an order's discount? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Are code-guessing protections stated, with the code length and alphabet they rely on? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the "unknown equals other-course" message rule consistent with the other failure messages? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a student already enrolled, an archived course and a free course? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the data an instructor sees about redemptions bounded (counts only, not students)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK020 Are the concepts assumed from #284 listed precisely enough to detect a conflict when its spec lands? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the release mechanism for expired checkouts specified without assuming the shape of #284's webhook? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the out-of-scope promotion types stated explicitly so none is implied by "coupons"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
